## Design

### 2026-10-13 – ![Screenshot 2026-10-13 at 12.08.08 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/hPE6VuGIngggJSZFqH7X60kS0VuTVv5c/41813bd3675133e82b72061586a04f2fb9854ae05799b7bf9f00bde3666d6d

**3h**

![Screenshot 2026-10-13 at 12.08.08 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/hPE6VuGIngggJSZFqH7X60kS0VuTVv5c/41813bd3675133e82b72061586a04f2fb9854ae05799b7bf9f00bde3666d6d0c.png)

Spent ~40 minutes watching an Onshape tutorial on how to build a Stirling engine, not accounting for pauses and replays.

![Screenshot 2026-10-13 at 12.09.12 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/hPE6VuGIngggJSZFqH7X60kS0VuTVv5c/2e2803d17739e656cd5ab62fcb9b1c07d085f465ec480d199d2446d1a17a95af.png)

Followed along with the video and made it through most of the video. Might pivot to a different tutorial that's more comprehensive/foundational. Despite it being a not-completely beginner-friendly tutorial, I learned a surprising amount in the process.

![Screenshot 2026-10-13 at 12.09.58 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/hPE6VuGIngggJSZFqH7X60kS0VuTVv5c/763920d0da787bc2d2b206608bcd252b6208655bcae29ce63dd145fbe0c8c626.png)

Applied those skills to draft the rough body of the LedX. I need to make a panel that can screw on and learn how to smooth out my prints, because I'm still new to 3D printing, and the print lines agitate me. The tip of the LedX is also a smooth curve, which looks good but isn't very functional if I want to add LEDs in later on.

### 2026-10-16 – ![Screenshot 2026-10-15 at 10.54.56 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/hPE6VuGIngggJSZFqH7X60kS0VuTVv5c/86c1bff02601c85861c15581b661e3f9e2975b73ff7e5db1ead6361a845496

**6h**

![Screenshot 2026-10-15 at 10.54.56 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/hPE6VuGIngggJSZFqH7X60kS0VuTVv5c/86c1bff02601c85861c15581b661e3f9e2975b73ff7e5db1ead6361a84549602.png)

First, I realized that my dimensions were not practical and did not resemble the real deal. I searched up what the real LEDX dimensions were, and tried to make mine to scale, except... my sketch was TERRIBLE. This resulted in the headache shown above.

![Screenshot 2026-10-15 at 10.55.08 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/hPE6VuGIngggJSZFqH7X60kS0VuTVv5c/b2a2004e82521874f61079edcede2740767dd05f3f29d1d4a7663244a613b96c.png)

Spent WAY too long following Claude's instructions on how to fix it and ended up with the monstrosity above. (not only visually, but the sketch was a fundamental issue that needed to be redone) Also wasted tons of tokens in the process, but I did figure out how to connect Claude using Onshape MCP. (I raged so hard I told Claude to do it for me, but it didn't work out very well, as shown above.)

![Screenshot 2026-10-15 at 10.54.31 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/hPE6VuGIngggJSZFqH7X60kS0VuTVv5c/7c20c27194827fc026f260573b3b20b9da5f60413139a9e8dd5e6aad6d241256.png)

Rage deleted a bunch of stuff and made it look tolerable, but the underlying issue was still bothering me tons.

![Screenshot 2026-10-15 at 10.58.34 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/hPE6VuGIngggJSZFqH7X60kS0VuTVv5c/5a104a1357efaaa3f761b56e17eb8fc1d3e8fee3d30489c016e195e8be599ffe.png)

Watched a few YouTube videos mainly on sketching, also got further into the Sterling Engine tutorial, and finally started piecing some dots together.

![Screenshot 2026-10-15 at 10.53.11 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/hPE6VuGIngggJSZFqH7X60kS0VuTVv5c/9ef70182565ddf98262788900d2e414a07afb09b746a712c7d97a424d4a9ccc1.png)

Finally, made this BEAUTIFUL sketch. At first, I couldn't figure out the ring opening; I was thinking of measuring the angle each line made with the horizontal and having those angles be equivalent to create an even opening, but I used some critical thinking skills and used rectangles with equal widths, and just drew a line from the center to the edges of those triangles. There's definitely better ways to do it out there, but I'm pretty new to this stuff.

![Screenshot 2026-10-15 at 10.53.25 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/hPE6VuGIngggJSZFqH7X60kS0VuTVv5c/b1bd37738a53ada6699f18a0a9000912c06d092a4ef2a4498364d968b34bb28c.png)

Extruded it, added some chamfers, and dare I say it's BEAUTIFUL. Going to hollow it out for the LEDS and the electronics tomorrow, maybe add a button and places for small screws.
